title: Crypto: AES-256-GCM encrypted entry
description: SAR archive with one entry encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Uses a test-only password-derived key. Validates AEAD encryption/decryption and AEAD-before-decompression ordering. The test key/password is fixed and documented as test-only.
notes: Test password: 'sar-test-password-aes'. DO NOT use for real data.
Key derived via PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with fixed test parameters.
